(define (domain barman)
  (:requirements :typing)
  (:types 
    hand level beverage dispenser container - object
    ingredient cocktail - beverage
    shot shaker - container
  )

  (:predicates
    (ontable ?c - container)
    (holding ?h - hand ?c - container)
    (handempty ?h - hand)
    (empty ?c - container)
    (contains ?c - container ?b - beverage)
    (clean ?c - container)
    (used ?c - container ?b - beverage)
    (dispenses ?d - dispenser ?i - ingredient)
    (shaker-empty-level ?s - shaker ?l - level)
    (shaker-level ?s - shaker ?l - level)
    (next ?l1 ?l2 - level)
    (unshaked ?s - shaker)
    (shaked ?s - shaker)
    (cocktail-part1 ?c - cocktail ?i - ingredient)
    (cocktail-part2 ?c

**Updating PDDL Actions**

I'm also defining the complex `pour-shot-to-clean-shaker` and `pour-shot-to-used-shaker` actions, including ingredient transfer and shaker state updates.

**Integrating Shaker and Shot Logic**

I'm also formalizing the `clean-shaker` action's preconditions.

I'm currently defining and refining PDDL actions, focusing on the intricate pouring and mixing processes. I am also detailing the `pour-shaker-to-shot` action, ensuring its preconditions and effects correctly handle ingredient transfer and the resulting state changes in both the shot glass and shaker.
